basic_information.title: Smart Personal Finance Manager and AI Investment Portfolio Forecaster
basic_information.summary: A comprehensive personal finance web application that tracks user spending habits and utilizes AI forecasting models to project the future performance of diversified investment portfolios.

abstract: Managing personal finances and making informed investment decisions can be daunting for the average individual. This project introduces a Smart Personal Finance Manager that automates expense tracking and provides actionable financial insights. Users can link their bank accounts securely via open banking APIs to categorize transactions automatically. The core innovation of this platform is the AI Investment Portfolio Forecaster, which uses Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks to analyze historical market data (stocks, ETFs, crypto) and project potential future portfolio values under various risk scenarios. The system helps users balance their budget while visualizing the long-term impact of their investment contributions.
problem_statement: Individuals struggle to simultaneously track their daily expenses and understand how their current savings rate will impact their long-term financial goals and investment growth.

primary: Develop an automated expense tracking system using open banking APIs.
Build a machine learning model to forecast investment portfolio performance.
Create an interactive dashboard for visualizing financial health and projections.
secondary: Allow users to simulate 'what-if' scenarios for different contribution amounts.

included: Bank account integration for read-only transaction syncing.
LSTM-based time-series forecasting for portfolio assets.
excluded: Direct trading or execution of investment orders.
Support for real estate or illiquid asset valuation.
scope.deployment_context: Web application hosted on a cloud platform with a separate microservice for heavy machine learning inferences.

reasons: Requires secure handling of sensitive financial data.
Integration with complex third-party banking APIs.
Developing accurate and robust time-series forecasting models.

phase_breakdown.phase: API integration and data pipeline setup

research_area.application_domain: Personal wealth management and financial planning

expected_outcomes: A secure web application capable of syncing real bank transactions.
A trained LSTM model that can forecast standard asset trajectories.
Interactive dashboards demonstrating current budget status and future wealth projections.
limitations: Financial markets are inherently unpredictable; AI forecasts are estimates, not guarantees.
Plaid integration requires sandbox data for demonstration purposes due to banking regulations.
High computational cost for running real-time ML inferences for many users.
future_scope: Integrate natural language processing to allow users to ask financial questions (e.g., 'How much did I spend on food last month?').
Add support for tracking and forecasting cryptocurrency portfolios.
